pages.text: $(thing)Effect Pages$() live in their own creative tab. To bind one to an Age, write the rare $(thing)Age Effect$() page before the chosen potion effect page. The selected effect is then applied randomly, without potion particles, to survival players in that Age.
Age effects are separate from instability. Even a stable Age can keep its age effect. They are expensive to write on purpose, and random Ages can only roll them very rarely.
Use $(thing)/mystcraft age_effect toggle$() in the current Age to pause or resume the effect. If the Age has no bound effect, the command reports that and does nothing.
